delete.description:
Always available, never rate limited, and idempotent: a control that stops
something must not itself be able to fail for being pressed twice.

post.description:
One observer tick. Synchronous on purpose: the latency budget is about a
second, and a lost tick is covered by the next one, so this never becomes a
durable Operation. The frame is held in memory and never stored.

Claimed.title: Claimed
Claimed.description:
A claim is the user's word. `verified` is always false here: only evidence
can verify a step, and that is a separate record (ADR-010).

Event.title: Event
Event.description: One entry in the session's ordered, content-free history.

ObservationConsent.title: ObservationConsent
ObservationConsent.description:
Explicit, separate consent for continuous watching. Accepting a screenshot
upload does not imply this, and the version pins what was actually agreed to.

ObservationTick.title: ObservationTick
ObservationTick.description: What the tick earned. `advance` is the only decision that moves anything.

ObserveRequest.title: ObserveRequest
ObserveRequest.description:
One admitted frame. No idempotency key: a tick is not a command, and
replaying one would be meaningless. Rate limits protect it instead.
